messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Annex III, 3.5.3

3.5.3. Emissions of hazardous substances The second and third paragraphs of section 1.5.13 do not apply where the main function of the machinery is the application of hazardous substances. However, the operator shall be protected against the risk of exposure to such hazardous emissions. Ride-on mobile machinery having application of hazardous substances as the main function shall be equipped with filtration cabs or equivalent safety measures.

response.text:
The second and third paragraphs of section 1.5.13 | do not apply | machinery whose main function is applying hazardous substances | where the main function of the machinery is the application of hazardous substances | "The second and third paragraphs of section 1.5.13 do not apply where the main function of the machinery is the application of hazardous substances."
operator | shallBeProtectedAgainst | risk of exposure to hazardous emissions | where the main function of the machinery is the application of hazardous substances | "the operator shall be protected against the risk of exposure to such hazardous emissions"
Ride-on mobile machinery with application of hazardous substances as main function | shallBeEquippedWith | filtration cabs or equivalent safety measures | ride-on mobile machinery whose main function is applying hazardous substances | "Ride-on mobile machinery having application of hazardous substances as the main function shall be equipped with filtration cabs or equivalent safety measures."
